peripherals.notes: KEY0 and KEY1 are active low with external 4.7 kohm pull-ups.
Two FPGA user LEDs: D5/LED0 and D6/LED1, active low. D4 is a supply LED; D1 is DONE. No V2 assignments reused.

peripherals.notes: LS_OE and CT_HPD tied to 3V3. HDMI 5V sourced via U16 from VIN. FPGA I/O standards and serialization remain unqualified.
